bot.q: Am I talking to a person?
bot.a: I'm Ju, BEJÚ's assistant (automated), not Benas or Simas. I answer common questions from a set list. To reach them:

ai.k: use ai,ai editing,edited by ai,ai tools,artificial intelligence,ai
ai.a: That's one for Benas and Simas to answer personally. Ask them here:

order.a: Pick a package in Pricing and press Order. It opens a secure Stripe checkout, then our welcome page shows the next steps.

choose.q: Can I choose the exact video?
choose.a: Yes. At checkout, name your channel or the exact videos to edit, and note any must-use moments, style or deadline. Or leave it to us: finding the best moments is our job.

afterpay.k: after i pay,after paying,next step,happens next,before i pay,before paying,pay first,upfront
afterpay.a: You land on our welcome page with the next steps, and we email you within 12 hours, 7 days a week, to confirm your order. If you gave your links at checkout, there's nothing else to send. Work starts once payment and usable footage are in.

upload.q: How do I send my footage?
upload.k: upload,send footage,send my footage,send file,wetransfer,dropbox,google drive,transfer
upload.a: If your files aren't online, use the upload folder we email you after you pay. It's shared only with your email address. No Google account? A WeTransfer, Dropbox or Google Drive link by email or WhatsApp works too.

send.k: what to send,what should i send,raw,original file,quality,riverside,camera,prepare,brief
send.a: The original file from your camera, Riverside, Zoom or editing app, and the whole recording. Timestamps of favourite moments, name spellings and anything we should never show help too.

call.q: Do I need a call or a form?
call.a: No call and no required form. There's an optional one-minute style form after you order. To talk it through, message Benas and Simas.

youtube.a: It helps us look at the episode, but the original file gives a better edit, so send it if you can.

howmany.q: How many clips should I order?
howmany.a: It depends how many distinct, useful moments your footage has, so don't buy more than it can support. Not sure? Start with one Short for $27, or ask for a free sample if your channel has 10,000+ subscribers.

prices.a: Short-form: $27 for one video, $60 for three ($20 each), $75 for five ($15 each). Long-form: $75, $180 ($60 each) or $255 ($51 each). Our standard Short is 15 to 40 seconds. For anything different, ask us before you order.

longform.a: Yes. $75 for one video, $180 for three, $255 for five, delivered in 48 hours. A short-form pack doesn't include a finished long-form episode.

sub.a: No. You buy a pack, with no lock-in. For something ongoing, message Benas and Simas.

discount.a: Bigger packs already cost less per video. For anything beyond that, message Benas and Simas. They decide.

launch.a: Yes, short films that show what your product does. They're quoted per project: send your product link and launch date for a quote within 24 hours.

quote.q: Can I get a custom quote?
quote.a: Yes. Special films and anything beyond the packs are quoted individually. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll come back with a quote.

fast.a: Short-form packs: 24 hours. Long-form: 48 hours. Weekends and holidays included: we work 7 days a week. The clock starts once payment, usable footage and your brief are confirmed. Very large orders can take longer; we agree timing upfront.

broken.q: What if my file is broken?
broken.a: We'll ask you to resend it, and the delivery clock starts after that.

expiry.k: expire,expiry,expires,expired,lapse,lapsed,valid for,how long is my pack,use my pack,never sent footage
expiry.a: Yes. Packs expire 14 days after you pay. If by then we still have no usable footage from you, or you've stopped replying, we close the order and the videos not yet made lapse. Until then, you can cancel under section 8 of our Terms.

revisions.a: Yes. Every order includes one round of revisions. Send all changes together within 48 hours of delivery, with timestamps if you can. Fixes usually come back the same day, but that's not guaranteed.

morerev.a: One round of revisions is included. A very different edit from the brief may count as a new order. If something feels off, talk to us and we'll see what's fair.

delivery.q: Where do I get my finished videos?
delivery.k: finished,download,receive,folder,where do i get,where will i get
delivery.a: Your edits arrive in a Google Drive folder for your order. We send you its link, and anyone with that link can view it, so keep it to yourself. You can download any time.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or get a refund?
cancel.k: cancel,cancel my order,cancel order,refund,get a refund,money back,refund policy,change my mind,changed my mind,refund after delivery,cancel after delivery
cancel.a: You can cancel for a full refund until we start work. If you buy as a consumer, you also have a 14-day right to cancel (section 8 of our Terms): if you cancel after we have started, you pay only for the videos already delivered, and the right ends once your videos are fully delivered. Packs expire 14 days after you pay: if by then we still have no usable footage from you, or you've stopped replying, we close the order and the videos not yet made lapse (section 2.4). Shorts packs with a baseline we agreed before you ordered are also covered by our 2× views guarantee (section 5). This doesn't limit your rights under the law. To cancel, email or WhatsApp us.

g-what.a: Yes, on Shorts packs where we agree your baseline before you order. If the average views of your pack's Shorts don't reach twice that baseline, we refund the pack price. The posting rules and how to claim are in section 5 of our Terms. Want it? Send us your channel before you order and we'll confirm your baseline within 24 hours.

g-cover.a: Only paid Shorts packs with a baseline we agreed before you ordered. An order placed without one is a normal order without the guarantee. Long-form edits, launch films and the free sample aren't covered. See the full rules.

g-double.q: Do all my clips have to double?
g-double.a: No. It's the package average, and a one-clip order is measured on that clip alone. See the full rules.

g-base.q: How is my baseline worked out?
g-base.a: It's the average public views of your last 10 clips that are at least 30 days old, and the target is twice that. With fewer than three such clips, the guarantee doesn't apply. See the full rules.

g-post.q: What do I have to do to stay covered?
g-post.a: Post each clip on the agreed account within 14 days of delivery, and keep it public, unchanged and unboosted for its first 30 days. See the full rules.

g-claim.q: How do I claim the guarantee?
g-claim.a: Follow the claim steps in the full rules. If you think your package missed the target, email us and Benas or Simas will review it.

viral.a: No, and nobody honest can promise that. We promise careful work, cut for retention.

unhappy.q: I'm not happy with my edit.
unhappy.a: I'm sorry to hear that. Every order includes one round of revisions, so tell Benas or Simas what's off and they'll look at it.

sample.q: Do you offer a free sample?
sample.k: free sample,sample,is it free,for free,trial,test edit,try,demo
sample.a: Yes, for channels with 10,000+ subscribers: one free Short from footage you already have, no payment or card details. One per person. If you like it, it comes clean, as an extra, with any pack you order. Smaller channel? Our packs start at $27.

sampletime.q: How long does the sample take?
sampletime.a: I don't want to promise a time I can't keep. Send your link through the form and Benas or Simas will confirm the timing.

sample2.q: Can I have a second free sample?
sample2.a: The free sample is one per person. If you want more, our packs start at $27.

pay.q: How do I pay? Is it secure?
pay.a: Payment goes through Stripe, so we never see or store your full card details. Checkout shows the payment options available to you.

invoice.a: I can't confirm the invoice or receipt format here. Email us and Benas or Simas will sort it.

own.a: You do, once the order is paid in full. Post them, reuse them, run them as ads. You keep your raw footage too.

portfolio.q: Will you show my work in your portfolio?
portfolio.k: show my,use my work,in your portfolio,showcase,case study,marketing
portfolio.a: We may, unless you tell us not to. Just say so and we won't. If we've already posted it, we take it off our website and our social accounts.

private.a: Your upload folder is shared only with your email address, never by link. Your edits arrive in a Google Drive folder for your order: anyone with its link can view it, so keep the link to yourself. We delete your raw footage once you've approved your edits. For confidentiality needs, email us.

contact.a: Email hello@bejucreative.digital, WhatsApp +370 695 75791, or DM @bejucreative on Instagram. We reply within 24 hours.

person.q: Can I talk to a person?
person.a: Of course. Send a message through the form, or email or WhatsApp us. Benas or Simas usually reply within 24 hours.

about.k: who are you,about,company,agency,studio,beju,based,lithuania,where are you,who edits,who will edit,editor,outsource,freelancer,account manager
about.a: We're BEJÚ Creative, two editors, Benas and Simas, based in Lithuania, with no account managers. We turn footage you already have into short videos for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.

whofor.a: Podcasters, coaches, personal brands and founders, plus launch videos for SaaS and apps. Clients named on our site include Sam Zia's team and onefjef.

work.a: Yes. The homepage gallery has podcast clips, personal-brand edits, an ad and launch films. Tap any clip to watch it.

what.a: Podcast episodes, coaching calls, talks to camera and raw clips, cut into short videos. You don't need to film anything new. We also do long-form edits and launch videos.

platforms.q: Which platforms do you format for?
platforms.a: YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok. Each Short is one vertical 9:16 file (1080 x 1920) with captions burned in, and it works on all three. Send name spellings so we get them right.

podcast.a: Yes, that's most of what we do. We keep enough of the question or setup for each answer to make sense, and finish each clip on its point.

coach.a: Yes. Talking-head lessons, demos and interviews, one useful takeaway per clip.

hello.a: Hi. Pick a topic below or type a question.

thanks.a: You're welcome. Just ask if anything else comes up.
